name: Hireful
niche: applicant tracking for UK SMEs and in-house recruiters
notes: Site says: "Our smarty pants techies have built an API solution into our product, so integrating is easy as pie." Site says: "Your hireful ATS integrates with just about anything, leaving you free to connect to your favourite HR tech." Terms state the registered address in England, and the company is registered in England and Wales. Pricing is an annual fee per recruiter licence, with the ATS starting at GBP 2,450 per year for the Go plan.
